lessons.title: 1. If-Else Statements
lessons.description: In Java, decision making uses `if`, `else if`, and `else`. Implement `isEven(int number)` returning `true` if number is divisible by 2.
learning_objectives: Use boolean conditions and modulo % operator in Java

tests.name: test_is_even
tests.test_code: if (!Solution.isEven(4)) throw new AssertionError("4 is even"); if (Solution.isEven(7)) throw new AssertionError("7 is odd");

lessons.title: 2. Logical Operators (&&, ||, !)
lessons.description: Java uses `&&` for AND, `||` for OR, and `!` for NOT. Implement `canAccessSystem(boolean hasBadge, boolean knowsPassword)`.
learning_objectives: Combine logical operators && and || in Java

tests.name: test_access
tests.test_code: if (!Solution.canAccessSystem(true, true)) throw new AssertionError("Expected true"); if (Solution.canAccessSystem(true, false)) throw new AssertionError("Expected false");

lessons.title: 3. Speed Limit Monitor (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Determine fine tier based on driving speed.

tests.name: test_ticket_category
tests.test_code: if (!"NONE".equals(Solution.getTicketCategory(55, 60))) throw new AssertionError("Expected NONE"); if (!"WARNING".equals(Solution.getTicketCategory(65, 60))) throw new AssertionError("Expected WARNING"); if (!"FINE".equals(Solution.getTicketCategory(80, 60))) throw new AssertionError("Expected FINE");

lessons.title: 4. Leap Year Checker (Practice)
lessons.description: Check if a year is a leap year in Java.
learning_objectives: Apply boolean logic to leap year calculations

tests.name: test_leap_year
tests.test_code: if (!Solution.isLeapYear(2000)) throw new AssertionError("2000 is leap"); if (Solution.isLeapYear(1900)) throw new AssertionError("1900 is not leap"); if (!Solution.isLeapYear(2024)) throw new AssertionError("2024 is leap");

lessons.title: 5. Unit 2 Checkpoint: Conditionals Mastery
lessons.description: Demonstrate complete understanding of Java control flow.
